Name: melee-machete-bot
Comment: Decisive: MACHEte (weapon) -> BOT. If B.healthRaw drops after the strike, native super.EvaluateHit->EvaluateHit_Player->ProcessMeleeHit works on PlayerBase-AI, so the fist-no-hit problem is in bare fists (raised stance etc). If B.healthRaw does NOT drop, the problem is the bot TARGET itself (native hit detect doesn't fire on PlayerBase-AI at all). ApplyZombieExtraDamage is NOT expected here (bot, not zombie).
